p-value ≈ 8.10×10⁻¹⁹⁴ (8.101e-194)

Main analysis: In the bladder cancer MeRIP-RNA dataset (n = 12,754 transcript-level records, no missing values), a Pearson chi-square test of independence was performed on a 3×3 contingency table of m6A methylation status (m6A Hyper / m6A Hypo / m6A no sig) × differential expression status (Up / Down / no-DEGs). Result: chi2 = 901.4452, dof = 4, p = 8.101e-194. Since the p-value is far below any conventional threshold, we reject independence: m6A methylation status and differential expression status are strongly associated (not independent).

Sensitivity check (i) — 2×2 merged classification (m6A significant vs non-significant × DEG vs no-DEG): chi2 = 323.172, dof = 1, p = 2.951e-72; Fisher's exact test p = 8.223e-54 (odds ratio = 3.94). Same conclusion.

Sensitivity check (ii) — after gene_id-level deduplication (rule: keep the first row of each gene in file order, 3,117 rows): 3×3 chi2 = 498.693, dof = 4, p = 1.285e-106. Same conclusion.

All three analyses agree: m6A status and DEG status are significantly non-independent.

Reported p-value (main 3×3 analysis, scientific notation): 8.10e-194

sensitivity_gene_dedup.rule: first row per gene_id in file order
